Add Pi agent routing contract (#205)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-67
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    - Add the exact `pi` AgentKind wire value across configuration, canonical encoding, PostgreSQL persistence, execution snapshots, and tracker MCP schemas.
    - Enforce Standard-only Pi Goal behavior and use the ordinary Codeon completion callback catalog.
    - Add migration 0133 with four downgrade guards plus focused fail-closed codec and schema tests.
    
    ## Verification
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker --test agent_selection`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --lib pi_round_trips_and_unknown_values_fail_closed`
    - Pi migration safety and migration directory authority tests
    - Pi config parsing, MCP schema enum, and callback catalog tests
    - `cargo check -p codeon-tracker -p codeon-postgres -p codeon --all-targets`
    
    PostgreSQL acceptance targets compile with `postgres-acceptance`; live execution was unavailable because no isolated `CODEON_TEST_DATABASE_URL` was configured.
